EmailTemplate.subject: Host a Blood Drive. Helping Sickle Cell Patients in Need.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi [NAME]
I wanted to reach out to you today, as a valued member of the Black community, in hosting another American Red Cross blood drive.
African American blood donors play a critical role in helping patients battling sickle cell disease to receive the most compatible blood match. Today, there aren’t enough African American donors to meet this urgent need.
Answer the call to help save those suffering from diseases, such as sickle cell, by hosting a Red Cross blood drive and collecting the most compatible blood for to help support over 100,000 sickle cell patients and families. Our Blood Saves Lives!
Please call me at <XXX_XXX_XXXX> or email me at <email address> to schedule your lifesaving blood drive today.
Sincerely, [NAME]
